Greed's gone green. Arcane avarice is transforming these once serene woods into a ghoulish gambling den. Welcome to the Cursino, where you need not be a vampire to fear the stakes.

The majority of Westwoods will be unavailable to the player at the start, using walls that are impermeable to Wall Clipping and Flight. In order to progress, the player must win the "Spin the Wheel!" minigame at the
Spin the Wheel! is a minigame by
Giocare that allows for the player to buy a number of spins using
Gold Coins. When the player buys a spin, the wheel will immediately activate and make the player either gain a certain item, an event, or the ability to access a leftward part of Westwoods.
